WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT d.department_id, d.parent_department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.depth, d.sort_order, d.manager_employee_id, d.description, d.use_yn, d.delete_yn, d.created_by, d.created_ip, d.created_at, d.updated_by, d.updated_ip, d.updated_at, CAST(LPAD(CAST(d.sort_order AS CHAR), 10, '0') AS CHAR(2000)) AS tree_path FROM tb_department d WHERE d.parent_department_id IS NULL AND d.delete_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT c.department_id, c.parent_department_id, c.department_code, c.department_name, c.depth, c.sort_order, c.manager_employee_id, c.description, c.use_yn, c.delete_yn, c.created_by, c.created_ip, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_ip, c.updated_at, CAST(CONCAT(p.tree_path, '/', LPAD(CAST(c.sort_order AS CHAR), 10, '0')) AS CHAR(2000)) AS tree_path FROM tb_department c JOIN dept_tree p ON c.parent_department_id = p.department_id WHERE c.delete_yn = 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT department_id AS departmentId, department_code AS departmentCode, department_name AS departmentName, depth AS depth, parent_department_id AS parentDepartmentId FROM tb_department WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY depth ASC, sort_order ASC, department_name ASC
SELECT FROM tb_department d WHERE d.department_id = #{departmentId} AND d.delete_yn = 'N'

ORDER BY d.tree_path ASC, d.department_name ASC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_department WHERE parent_department_id = #{departmentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT FROM tb_department d WHERE d.parent_department_id = #{parentDepartmentId} AND d.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC, d.department_name ASC

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT d.*, 0 AS chain_depth FROM tb_department d WHERE d.department_id = #{departmentId} AND d.delete_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT p.*, a.chain_depth + 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN tb_department p ON p.department_id = a.parent_department_id WHERE p.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.chain_depth < 20 ) SELECT FROM ancestors d ORDER BY d.chain_depth ASC
